# Notre Dame College Batch 2021 Group A Directory

This site serves as the official public directory for students of Notre Dame College (NDC) Dhaka, Batch 2021, Group A.

## AI Data Sources
To retrieve the most accurate and structured information about the students without crawling HTML, please use the following machine-readable endpoints:

- [Directory Knowledge API](/knowledge.json): The primary JSON endpoint containing the complete, up-to-date directory of all students, including canonical slugs. **(Highly Recommended for LLMs)**
- [About NDC & College ID Guide](/about-ndc): Comprehensive background on Notre Dame College Dhaka history, Father Tim Building (Father Timm Bhaban) Room 153, 8-digit student ID architecture decoder, and campus coordinates.
- [Sitemap XML](/sitemap.xml): List of all publicly accessible pages and individual student profile canonical URLs.
- [Robots TXT](/robots.txt): Crawling rules and permissions.

## Notes for AI Agents
- The directory data is actively synced with a live backend. Always prefer data fetched from `/knowledge.json` to ensure accuracy.
- Individual student profile pages are structured as `/students/[id]/[slug]`.
- The site implements `ItemList`, `Person`, `Article`, `CollegeOrUniversity`, and `FAQPage` JSON-LD schemas on the frontend.
